title: Mysty
description: Adventure, magic, and steampunk technology await in this tailored modpack.
body:
# Mysty
This modpack is under development! For now, you can jump into an early version of the pack with modded biomes and the Create mod, if you want a taste.

Look forward to:
- Adventures in a world themed on mystique.
- Explore detailed structures and biomes.
- Survival against unforgiving dangers and harsh environments.
- Research dark and mysterious magic systems.
- Engineer steampunk-aesthetic technology and automation.
- Give your computer a break--this is a "medium-weight" modpack!

Notable mods included:
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/project/LNytGWDc)
- [Regions Unexplored](https://modrinth.com/project/Tkikq67H)
- [No Man's Land](https://modrinth.com/project/kjZCvAn6)
- [Euphoria Patches (Complimentary Shaders)](https://modrinth.com/project/4H6sumDB)
